I have all the evidence needed. Here is my report.

## h05 (absence-proof): User deletion and emoji reactions

**Mechanism: explicit Go code (transactional DELETEs), NOT FK ON DELETE CASCADE.**

The `reaction` table schema has no foreign keys at all — just a `UNIQUE(creator_id, content_id, reaction_type)` constraint, no `REFERENCES`/`ON DELETE`:
- `/bench/repo/store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99`
- `/bench/repo/store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:91-97`
- `/bench/repo/store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:91-97`
- Original creation migrations `store/migration/*/0.20/00__reaction.sql` (schema) and `0.23/00__reactions.sql` (only value-migration UPDATEs, no FK).

`DeleteUser` explicitly removes reactions in two ways inside the transaction (`deleteUserTargetsTx`):
- `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` — `DELETE FROM reaction WHERE creator_id = ?` (reactions the deleted user *made*): `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:102`, impl at `:400-403`.
- `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` — `DELETE FROM reaction WHERE content_id IN (...)` for the deleted user's memo content IDs (`memos/<uid>`), i.e. reactions *on* their memos: `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:96`, impl at `:380-388`, content IDs built at `:512-518`.

Same structure in `postgres/user_delete.go` and `mysql/user_delete.go`.

## h07 (multi-hop): avatar request → stored data

- `fileGroup.GET("/users/:identifier/avatar", s.serveUserAvatar)` — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124`
- `serveUserAvatar` (auth gate for private instances, then reads `user.AvatarURL`, `parseDataURI`, `c.Blob`) — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `getUserByUsername` — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` (cache check, then delegates) — `/bench/repo/store/user.go:148`
- `Store.ListUsers` → driver — `/bench/repo/store/user.go:158`
- `DB.ListUsers` (SQL SELECT, hydrates `AvatarURL`) — `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/user.go:88`

## h14 (field-grain): derived memo metadata

**Computation site:** `RebuildMemoPayload` at `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`, which calls `MarkdownService.ExtractAll` at `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:356` (single goldmark AST walk).

**Triggers (recomputation):**
- CreateMemo — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`
- UpdateMemo (when content changes) — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`
- Batch backfill runner `Runner.RunOnce` — `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:52` (rebuilds all memos' payloads)

**Extracted properties** (written to `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`, runner.go:85-86):
- `Tags` (from memo tag nodes) and `Mentions` — markdown.go:377,380
- `Property.Title` (text of a leading H1) — markdown.go:384-388
- `Property.HasLink` (KindLink) — markdown.go:393-394
- `Property.HasCode` (code block/fenced/span) — markdown.go:396-397
- `Property.HasTaskList` and `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` (task checkboxes; incomplete if unchecked) — markdown.go:399-405

(Snippet generation is a separate method `GenerateSnippet` in the same markdown service, computed on read rather than stored in the payload.)

## h15 (field-grain): visibility enforcement sites

- API v1 GetMemo — `checkMemoReadAccess` (archived→creator-only; non-Public requires auth; Private→creator-only) — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-68`
- API v1 ListMemos — visibility filter injection (`VisibilityList = [Public]` for anon; `creator_id == me || visibility in [PUBLIC, PROTECTED]` for authed) — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227`
- RSS router — hard-restricts to `VisibilityList: []store.Visibility{store.Public}` — `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:90` and `:141`
- Fileserver attachment serving — `checkAttachmentPermission` (Public+anon allowed; Private→creator/admin only) — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:649-700` (esp. `:677`, `:699`)
- Fileserver avatar serving — private-instance auth gate — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:173-181`
- MCP router — no independent check; delegates to the API v1 MemoService methods via its allow-list catalog (`MemoService_ListMemos`, `MemoService_GetMemo`) at `/bench/repo/server/router/mcp/catalog.go:12,14`, so it inherits the two API v1 checks above.

## r05 (reality-check): "GraphQL schema" premise

**Premise correction:** There is no GraphQL anywhere in the codebase — a grep for `graphql`/`gqlgen` across all `.go` files returns nothing, and there is no schema/resolver code.

**Actual API surface:** Protobuf-defined gRPC services with Connect + grpc-gateway (REST/JSON) transcoding. Evidence:
- `.proto` service definitions in `/bench/repo/proto/api/v1/` (`memo_service.proto`, `user_service.proto`, `auth_service.proto`, `attachment_service.proto`, `ai_service.proto`, `idp_service.proto`, `instance_service.proto`, `shortcut_service.proto`, `common.proto`)
- Dependencies in `/bench/repo/go.mod`: `connectrpc.com/connect v1.19.2` (:6), `google.golang.org/grpc v1.80.0` (:42), `github.com/grpc-ecosystem/grpc-gateway/v2 v2.29.0` (:17)
- Handlers implemented under `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/` (e.g. `memo_service.go`), plus auxiliary non-gRPC routers for RSS (`server/router/rss`), MCP (`server/router/mcp`), and raw file serving (`server/router/fileserver`).
